changelog:
📄 Feishu Doc Manager | 飞书文档管理器
Seamlessly publish Markdown content to Feishu Docs with automatic formatting.
将 Markdown 内容无缝发布到飞书文档，自动渲染格式。
🎯 Problems Solved:
• Markdown tables auto-convert to formatted lists
• One-click permission management  
• Batch writing for long content
✨ Features:
• Smart Markdown publishing
• Permission management
• Document operations
